description: Card-to-template mapping for mythology-based card game. Each card is paired with an appropriate frame template based on its mythology and rarity tier.

rarity_distribution.Legendary: 5% of cards — Gods and mythic beings
rarity_distribution.Rare: 15% of cards — Powerful creatures and heroes
rarity_distribution.Uncommon: 30% of cards — Standard creatures and warriors
rarity_distribution.Common: 50% of cards - Basic creatures, artifacts, and minions
